verdict.rationale: Semgrep documents an official MCP server (docs.semgrep.dev/mcp) that would let AI agents/LLMs invoke Semgrep via natural-language tool calls, but a hands-on probe shows the MCP server failed the stdio initialize handshake in practice ('Semgrep is not installed or not in your PATH' despite semgrep being on PATH), and a community report notes an LLM (o1) hallucinating non-existent semgrep functions when trying to operate it. This is a documented capability contradicted by concrete hands-on failure. Missing for 10: a successful end-to-end NL-command demo, a working MCP handshake, and independent corroboration that natural-language operation reliably works.
